facts: No. Mobium's confirmation means only that the device stored the language tag, and it says so: whether the app has that translation is not something Android reports, so check the screen.
Android accepts a tag like zz-ZZ, reads it back as asked, and the app renders in its default language.
On iOS the language is a launch argument, and the answer says the same: whether the app has the translation shows only on the screen.
note: 49, plus the skill's device-state section ('Setting a language confirms the device stored the tag, not that the app speaks it'), retrieved second. Checked against agent/locale.go:72-84; iOS fact added from the same handler.
